title: Rethinking the Test-Time Prompt Tuning Objective from the Perspective of Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2608.30230v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-time prompt tuning (TPT) has emerged as a powerful paradigm, refining prompts for each test sample via entropy minimization (EM) over multiple augmented views. However, we identify a limitation in the standard EM-based adaptation: it inherently drives the model toward overconfident predictions disregarding sample-specific uncertainty, leading to significant calibration degradation. To address these limitations, we propose a new objective that replaces the conventional EM loss by aligning the original-view prediction with a target distribution derived from augmented views via cross-entropy, while adversarially incorporating the entropy of the target distribution to capture sample-specific uncertainty. Furthermore, to better construct this target distribution, we apply confidence-aware temperature scaling to each augmented-view prediction according to its confidence, sharpening confident predictions while softening uncertain ones. translated_title: 从校准的视角重新思考测试时提示调优目标
translated_abstract: 测试时提示调优已成为一种强大的范式，它通过对多个增强视图进行熵最小化（EM）来为每个测试样本优化提示。然而，我们发现了基于标准熵最小化的适应方法的一个局限性：它本质上会驱使模型产生过度自信的预测，而忽视了样本特定的不确定性，从而导致显著的校准性能退化。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一个新的目标函数，用交叉熵将原始视图的预测与从增强视图导出的目标分布进行对齐，以取代传统的熵最小化损失，同时以对抗的方式引入目标分布的熵来捕捉样本特定的不确定性。此外，为了更好地构建这一目标分布，我们根据每个增强视图预测的置信度对其应用置信度感知的温度缩放，锐化高置信度的预测，同时软化不确定的预测。
tldr: 本文从校准视角重新审视测试时提示调优，指出熵最小化会导致模型过度自信和校准退化，并提出一种结合交叉熵对齐、对抗熵项与置信度感知温度缩放的新目标来捕捉样本特定不确定性，从而改善校准性能。
